# 00_Index

The full catalog of the engineering document templates — all 56, organized by SWEBOK Knowledge Area, with companion standards, maturity tiers, and a suggested lifecycle reading order — lives in the [`README.md`](../README.md) one level up.

This folder holds cross-cutting supporting material that isn't tied to a single knowledge area:

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `Glossary.md` | Project-wide shared vocabulary (ISO/IEC/IEEE 24765 / SEVOCAB style) — referenced by every other document. |
